useCases.title: ePHI Access Audit
useCases.value: HIPAA Security Rule requires accounting of disclosures; supports minimum necessary and investigation workflows.

useCases.title: HIPAA Transmission Security
useCases.value: Detects cleartext PHI on protocols or TLS versions below policy (e.g., TLS 1.0).

useCases.title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Clause 7.2 — Competence evidence: role-based training completion
useCases.value: Replaces the annual LMS export with a daily compliance signal. HR can notify managers proactively rather than after the audit finding.

useCases.title: SOC 2 CC6.6 — Encryption-in-transit validation: cleartext protocols crossing the trust boundary
useCases.value: Replaces annual TLS-compliance scans with a continuous signal, so drift (a new container accidentally exposing http) is caught within 30 minutes.

useCases.title: SOC 2 C1.1 — Confidentiality: sensitive-data exposure at the egress boundary
useCases.value: C1.1 confidentiality assurance hinges on continuous detection of data leaving the boundary. This UC gives the DPO a queryable control output.

useCases.title: HIPAA Risk Analysis Evidence — Asset & ePHI System Inventory
useCases.value: Correlates systems that store or transmit ePHI with vulnerability and patch posture so security leaders can evidence an ongoing, documented risk analysis aligned with the Security Rule.

useCases.title: HIPAA Risk Management — Control Deficiency Tracking
useCases.value: Tracks open HIPAA control gaps from assessments and pen tests through remediation so risk is reduced to reasonable and appropriate levels, not just documented once.

useCases.title: Information System Activity Review — Cross-Source ePHI Access Summary
useCases.value: Produces a daily leadership-ready rollup of who touched ePHI across EHR, VPN, and databases so workforce activity review obligations are operationally met, not ad hoc.

useCases.title: Workforce Clearance — HR Hire vs AD Account Creation
useCases.value: Flags Active Directory accounts created or enabled before HR clearance effective date, supporting workforce clearance procedures for roles with ePHI access.

useCases.title: Termination — Access Revocation Within Policy Window
useCases.value: Detects logons, VPN sessions, or EHR access after HR termination timestamp so access revocation SLAs are provably enforced.

useCases.title: Security Awareness & Training — Phish Simulation Failure to ePHI Risk
useCases.value: Links repeated phishing test failures to subsequent risky ePHI handling patterns so awareness gaps become targeted coaching, not checkbox training.

useCases.title: Login Monitoring & Security Incident Procedures — Brute Force to Clinical SSO
useCases.value: Surfaces credential stuffing and password spray against Hyperspace/SSO endpoints so incidents are detected and handled under HIPAA security incident procedures.

useCases.title: Contingency Plan — Backup Job Success for ePHI Databases
useCases.value: Monitors backup completion for Clarity/Caboodle and clinical data stores so availability safeguards in the contingency plan are continuously evidenced.

useCases.title: Periodic Evaluation — Control Test Evidence Ingest
useCases.value: Centralizes periodic technical test results (MFA coverage, encryption checks) with timestamps for HIPAA periodic technical and non-technical evaluation evidence.

useCases.title: Business Associate Contracts — BAA Coverage for Connected Systems
useCases.value: Highlights new interfaces or SaaS tenants talking to ePHI systems without a registered BAA so legal can close contract gaps before production traffic carries PHI.

useCases.title: Business Associate Agreements — Expiry & Auto-Renewal Monitoring
useCases.value: Prevents lapsed BAAs for vendors that process ePHI by tracking expiry, auto-renew flags, and required amendment workflows.

useCases.title: Sanction Policy — Privileged Abuse on EHR Audit Logs
useCases.value: Detects workforce sanctions triggers such as repeated self-family lookups or audit log tampering attempts by IT admins supporting HIPAA sanction policy enforcement.

useCases.title: Unique User Identification — Shared or Generic EHR Accounts
useCases.value: Finds authentication and EHR events tied to shared kiosk or interface accounts so every action can be attributed to an identified user as required for ePHI access.

useCases.title: Emergency Access Procedure — Downtime / Break-Glass Account Usage
useCases.value: Audits emergency and downtime accounts touching production ePHI so procedural safeguards around emergency access are reviewable and time-bound.

useCases.title: Automatic Logoff — Stale Clinical Workstation Sessions
useCases.value: Identifies unusually long Citrix/VDI sessions and unlocked Windows consoles in patient care areas where automatic logoff may be misconfigured.

useCases.title: Encryption of ePHI at Rest — TDE / BitLocker Status for Clinical Datastores
useCases.value: Surfaces SQL Server instances hosting Clarity that lack Transparent Data Encryption or hosts missing full-disk encryption so at-rest ePHI protections meet the addressable implementation specification…

useCases.title: Audit Controls — High-Volume ePHI Read Baseline & Anomaly
useCases.value: Uses statistical baselines on audited ePHI reads to detect abnormal access volumes indicative of snooping or compromised credentials while proving audit control operation.

useCases.title: Integrity — Unexpected UPDATE/DELETE on PHI Tables (Clarity/Caboodle)
useCases.value: Alerts on bulk or off-hours SQL changes to tables holding patient demographics or clinical facts so improper alteration of ePHI is detected and investigated.

useCases.title: Entity Authentication — Smart Card / Certificate Logon Failures
useCases.value: Tracks failed certificate-based logons to clinical workstations and VDI pools so weak or expired credentials cannot silently undermine strong authentication for ePHI.

useCases.title: Transmission Security — TLS 1.0/1.1 Deprecation for EHR Integrations
useCases.value: Highlights legacy TLS usage on connections carrying HL7/HTTPS to integration engines so transmission safeguards for ePHI meet current encryption standards.

useCases.title: Access Control — Role-Based Violations (Coder Accessing Medication Admin)
useCases.value: Detects EHR workspace or activity codes inconsistent with HR job role, supporting least-privilege access control for ePHI workflows.

useCases.title: Remote ePHI Access — MFA Gap for VPN + O365 Clinical Mail
useCases.value: Surfaces successful VPN or Exchange Online logons without MFA claim for users in ePHI-privileged groups so remote access meets organizational authentication policy.

useCases.title: FHIR / SMART on FHIR App Access to ePHI Scopes
useCases.value: Monitors OAuth token grants and FHIR resource access so only authorized applications and scopes can read or write clinical data exposed via interoperability APIs.

useCases.title: Medical Device Integration — Unapproved HL7 Feeds to EMPI
useCases.value: Detects new sending facilities or IP addresses pushing ADT/ORM traffic into the integration engine without change control, protecting access control around device-mediated ePHI flows.

useCases.title: Endpoint Controls — ePHI Clipboard/Print from VDI
useCases.value: Tracks clipboard redirection and client drive mapping events on clinical VDI where policies should block exfiltration paths for ePHI.

useCases.title: Transmission Security — Unencrypted SMTP with PHI Patterns
useCases.value: Alerts when internal mail relays accept messages on port 25 without TLS that contain medical record number or DOB patterns, evidencing safeguards for ePHI in motion.

useCases.title: Integrity — Caboodle / Clarity ETL Job Failures & Partial Loads
useCases.value: Detects failed or partial analytics warehouse loads that could silently skew quality reporting built on ePHI, supporting integrity of data used for care and compliance analytics.

useCases.title: Workstation Security — Unattended Unlocked Sessions in Clinical Pods
useCases.value: Correlates long gaps between workstation unlock events in nursing stations with active Hyperspace sessions to reduce shoulder-surfing and unauthorized viewing risks.

useCases.title: Device & Media Controls — USB Mass Storage on ePHI Workstations
useCases.value: Captures removable media mount attempts on endpoints that access Hyperspace so device and media control policies for ePHI workstations are enforceable and auditable.

useCases.title: Media Controls — Large PHI Print Jobs to Non-Secure Printers
useCases.value: Monitors unusually large chart print jobs routed to non-secure print queues so physical disclosure risks from uncontrolled hardcopy are reduced.

useCases.title: Facility vs Logical Access — Badge-In Without VPN/SSO for Remote Roles
useCases.value: Correlates physical badge events with absence of corresponding VPN or SSO session for users tagged as onsite-only, highlighting impossible travel or credential sharing.

useCases.title: Workstation Use — After-Hours Login from Non-Clinical IP Space
useCases.value: Flags Citrix/VDI launches for inpatient CPOE roles originating from residential ISP ASNs outside hospital guest WiFi, supporting workstation use policies in shared clinical environments.

useCases.title: Minimum Necessary — Access Outside Active Care Team
useCases.value: Compares chart opens to on-service treatment team membership so accesses without an active treatment relationship are surfaced for minimum necessary review.

useCases.title: Break-Glass — Emergency Access Reason Codes & Post-Review
useCases.value: Ensures every break-glass chart override includes a reason code and is followed by supervisor attestation within policy timelines.

useCases.title: Non-Treating Provider — Specialty Mismatch Chart Access
useCases.value: Highlights when users in non-clinical specialties repeatedly open inpatient charts outside their documented specialty cohort, a common snooping pattern.

useCases.title: Bulk ePHI Export — Clarity SQL / Caboodle Extract Volume Spike
useCases.value: Detects unusually large SELECT/BCP operations against patient fact tables that may indicate unauthorized bulk download of ePHI for exfiltration.

useCases.title: After-Hours ePHI Access — Billing Users on Inpatient Charts
useCases.value: Surfaces patient chart access during overnight windows by revenue cycle roles where business need is uncommon, supporting workforce training and sanctions workflows.

useCases.title: Deceased Patient Records — Access After Death Date
useCases.value: Monitors chart access after documented death timestamps for users not on approved post-mortem workflows (HIM, organ donation, medical examiner).

useCases.title: VIP / High-Profile Patient — Elevated Access Monitoring
useCases.value: Applies extra scrutiny to any user accessing patients on the VIP/high-profile flag list to deter and detect snooping.

useCases.title: Research Access — Chart Views Without Active IRB Consent Flag
useCases.value: Correlates research coordinator EHR access with IRB-approved patient rosters to catch out-of-protocol chart reviews.

useCases.title: Accounting of Disclosures — Registry vs EHR-Logged Disclosures
useCases.value: Reconciles disclosure events recorded in the accounting of disclosures repository with interface and manual disclosure logs so patients receive accurate histories.

useCases.title: Patient Portal — Suspicious MyChart Password Reset & MFA Changes
useCases.value: Detects takeover patterns on patient portals that could expose ePHI and undermine patient trust and access controls.

useCases.title: Breach Discovery — Time-to-Detect from First PHI Indicator
useCases.value: Measures elapsed time between earliest technical indicator of a potential PHI incident and formal incident creation so discovery timelines support Breach Notification Rule evidence.

useCases.title: Breach Risk Assessment — Four-Factor Documentation Tracking
useCases.value: Stores structured answers for nature/extent of PHI, unauthorized recipient, actual acquisition, and mitigation so breach vs non-breach determinations are auditable.

useCases.title: Individual Notification — Letter Generation & Mailing Evidence
useCases.value: Tracks generation, print, and certified mail tracking numbers for breach letters within the 60-day window to support individual notification compliance.

useCases.title: HHS Secretary Notification — 500+ Individuals Threshold Watch
useCases.value: Rolling count of affected individuals per incident versus the 500-person statutory threshold for timely HHS portal submission.

useCases.title: Media Notification — Large-State Resident Threshold Tracking
useCases.value: Computes per-state affected resident counts to trigger prominent media notice obligations when thresholds in a jurisdiction or overall breach size demand public notice.

useCases.title: Breach Log / Incident Register — Immutable Chronological Record
useCases.value: Maintains a searchable chronological register of all breach-suspected and confirmed incidents with status transitions for OCR-style examinations.

useCases.title: Breach Remediation — Control Implementation Evidence Post-Incident
useCases.value: Links post-breach corrective actions (MFA rollout, DLP rules) to measurable control telemetry so remediation is demonstrable, not narrative-only.

useCases.title: Annual Breach Reporting — Trend of Affected Individuals & Root Cause
useCases.value: Aggregates year-over-year breach statistics and root causes for leadership and regulatory annual summaries.

useCases.title: Business Associate Access — VPN/SSO Sessions Originating from BA Address Space
useCases.value: Surfaces new source ASNs or IP ranges used by business associates connecting into hosted EHR jump boxes so BA access stays within contracted technical boundaries.

useCases.title: BAA Compliance Evidence — Control Attestations vs Technical Telemetry
useCases.value: Joins annual BA questionnaire answers (encryption, logging) with Splunk-ingested technical proof points so subcontractor compliance is evidence-based, not checkbox-only.

useCases.title: Subcontractor Access — Downstream API Keys Touching ePHI Interfaces
useCases.value: Monitors first-seen API keys or OAuth clients used by BA subcontractors against an approved key registry so the extended BAA chain does not introduce unreviewed ePHI paths.

useCases.title: Third-Party Data Sharing — O365 Sharing Links to External Domains on PHI Libraries
useCases.value: Surfaces SharePoint or OneDrive anonymous or company links created in sites labeled for clinical operations that resolve to recipients outside the covered entity tenant.

useCases.title: Cloud Service Provider — ePHI Hosting Admin Actions in AWS or Azure Audit
useCases.value: Tracks CSP administrator and break-glass activity against accounts or subscriptions tagged as hosting replicated ePHI backups or analytics, supporting BA and cloud subcontractor oversight.

useCases.title: Audit-log continuity: detect indexing gap indicating lost evidence
useCases.value: Without continuous audit logs, compliance claims are unfalsifiable. Auditors across GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOC 2, and SOX all treat log-gaps as a finding. This UC lets a customer show the auditor a gr…

useCases.title: Log tamper detection via write-once-read-many chain-of-custody
useCases.value: Produces defensible chain-of-custody evidence: auditors can be shown a 30-day view in which every bucket was either green or had a timestamped remediation ticket.

useCases.title: Log signing chain integrity — cryptographic signature drift on evidence archive
useCases.value: Replaces the quarterly 'we sampled 10 logs and checked hashes' audit procedure with a continuous control whose output is either 'zero breaks for the period' or a named remediation record. This is the…

useCases.title: Search-head audit-trail completeness — deleted or rewritten search jobs
useCases.value: Gives the Splunk admin team a defensible 'every search run is accounted for' control rather than the weaker 'we have search logging enabled'.

useCases.title: Multi-regulator breach-notification SLA tracker (24h NIS2 / 72h GDPR / 72h HIPAA)
useCases.value: Most enforcement actions against supervisory breaches (ICO, DPC, BaFin) focus on notification timeliness. This UC turns the obligation into a visible KPI instead of a post-facto audit finding.

useCases.title: Data-subject breach communication timeline tracker (Art.34 / §164.404)
useCases.value: Data-subject communication is routinely cited in enforcement decisions (Meta, Uber, British Airways); measuring it is the only credible evidence of 'taken reasonable efforts'.

useCases.title: Encryption-at-rest coverage gap — unencrypted storage with regulated data
useCases.value: Unencrypted regulated data is the most common PCI 3.5 / HIPAA finding — preventing it from appearing on the audit spreadsheet is the goal.

useCases.title: Certificate / TLS posture — weak cipher and expired-cert detection
useCases.value: Moves TLS posture from 'we scan quarterly' to 'we proved every TLS endpoint was compliant for every day of the period'.

useCases.title: TLS downgrade / legacy-cipher handshake spike
useCases.value: Catches silent downgrade issues introduced by load-balancer config drift before they become an audit finding or data-exposure incident.

useCases.title: Backup encryption and air-gap integrity — tamper detection on immutable storage
useCases.value: Prevents the compliance claim of 'we have immutable backups' from silently becoming untrue.

useCases.title: Backup repository TLS posture — aged or weak-cipher endpoints
useCases.value: Closes a gap pattern observed in DORA inspections where the backup plane had older TLS than the production plane.

useCases.title: Mandatory security training — completion SLA by role
useCases.value: Moves completion from a retrospective export to a continuously-known KPI.

useCases.title: Privileged-role specialist training — admins lacking annual deep-training
useCases.value: Makes the 'role-based training' requirement evidence-backed rather than policy-on-paper.

useCases.title: Developer data-handling training — prod-access engineers lacking training
useCases.value: Links IdP posture to training posture — the evidence auditors actually ask for.

useCases.title: Retention execution evidence — records past retention still present
useCases.value: Retention failures quickly become GDPR enforcement actions — continuous monitoring is the only real defence.

useCases.title: Disposal workflow completion — failed disposals requiring manual review
useCases.value: Ensures the disposal pipeline is as observable as the ingest pipeline.

useCases.title: Retention policy drift — system config vs policy catalogue
useCases.value: Turns retention policy adherence into a continuously-measured metric per system.

useCases.title: Cryptographic erasure attestation — per-asset destruction evidence
useCases.value: Solves the 'how do I prove we actually erased that data?' question that every DPO faces.
